chunks: But they called him a liar, and We saved him and those with him in the Ark, and drowned the others who rejected Our signs, for they were a people purblind.
ai.seo_question: How did God save the prophet and his followers when their people denied him?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-A'raf, this verse highlights the pattern of divine deliverance for the faithful amidst communal denial, specifically referencing the Ark (Al-Fulk) as a vessel of salvation. Shia scholarship often emphasizes the 'spiritual blindness' (A'meen) of the disbelievers as a consequence of rejecting clear signs (Ayat), linking this historical event to the broader eschatological narrative of the Ahl al-Bayt's endurance against opposition.
